record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly lower Adam learning rate from 7e-4 to 5e-4 and dropout from 0.10 to 0.08. Smaller updates may stabilize optimization of normalized item embeddings, while slightly lower dropout preserves context signal in the predominantly short histories. Keep all other settings, masked-item loss, architecture and inference fixed, including seed 42, at most 200 epochs and 200 batches per epoch.
